top_hits.content: Data Dictionary Row: * `ltv`: Loan-to-Value ratio at origination (numeric).
Data Dictionary Row: * `delinquency_status`: Current delinquency status (0=Current, 1=30D, 2=60D, etc.).
Data Dictionary Row: * `delinquency_status`: Updated delinquency status.

Validation Rule [delinquency_progression]: {"description": "Delinquency status cannot jump more than 1 month at a time.", "type": "sequential", "check": "delinquency_status(t) <= delinquency_status(t-1) + 1"}
